dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: This place is amazing, beautiful, and peaceful... There's so many wonderful things I've never seen before.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I doubt there's any other place in Teyvat that can compare to this.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Even if you just give me a tiny tent, I'll still be super comfortable here.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Oh, but... if I'm gonna be camping outside, I'll have to trouble you for some firewood to make a campfire...

choices.text: No need for that — it's temperate here year-round!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Th—Thank you... I hope me being here isn't too much of an imposition...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Um... If there's anything I can help with around here, please do let me know!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I used to spend a lot of time cleaning and tidying the house and yard. That was a while ago, but I'm probably still okay at it...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Aw... That's extremely kind of you... Thank you ever so much!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Uh, I guess I should stop with all the formalities before I ruin the mood...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Alright, I'll make myself at home, then. I want to do a detailed survey of this place... I'll do my best to understand your design philosophy!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: That way, I can help you out if you ever need it.

choices.text: All a guest needs to do is make themselves at home.
Of course I'd get you what you need!
